name: hello-mq
description: 消息队列、事件流平台与可靠消息模式文档（Message Queue & Event Streaming Explorer）

scripts.collect:docker: for script in demos/*/docker/run.sh; do bash "$script"; done && node scripts/normalize-docker-evidence.js
scripts.check:compose: for f in demos/*/*/docker-compose.yml; do docker compose -p probe -f $f --env-file .env.versions config --quiet || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run check:versions && npm run check:installs && npm run check:project && npm run check:docker-catalog && npm run docs:build
